subject: general
question: Who was/is a successful Indian business tycoon and was the founder of Reliance Industries?
solution:
Correct Answer **Dhirubhai Ambani**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dhirubhai Ambani **was a successful Indian business tycoon.
 
• He was the founder of **Reliance Industries.**
 
• He started Reliance Industries in **1966 as a small textile manufacturer.**
 
• Over the years, he expanded the company into a** diverse range of businesses.**
 
• These businesses** include telecommunications, petrochemicals, and retail.**
 
• His entrepreneurial efforts have had a significant impact on the** Indian business landscape.**
